name: DevRoom_Vegetation
comment: The dev room in the vegetation valley (map devroom_vegetation): the vegetation map's generator world (seed, terrain, every foliage kind: pine forest, broadleaf forest, dead wood, mixed forest, meadow, wheat field, pond) laid out around the whole dev room, which comes in by "include" (level_include.h, docs/ZOMBIE_MAP.md 'Level includes') and so always tracks data/levels/devroom.json: its brushes, entities, labels, spawns, vehicles, pumps, spikes, water pool, puddles, post volumes and weather, at the dev room's own coordinates. "ground" flattens the terrain to y = 0 (concrete, no trees or grass) under its footprint, so every dev room command and script coordinate works unchanged. The terrain is the vegetation map's lowered by 14 m (ground at 0) and 2.8 km across, so the 1.3 km landmark tower and the 500 m ballistics range fit. Engine coordinates: X east, Z south (north = -Z). Format: docs/ZOMBIE_MAP.md.

features._comment: The dev room audio range's open field (docs/AUDIO_PROCEDURAL.md 'Audio range'): nothing within 450 m of (-700, 0, 300), as on the dev room's endless floor: a flat meadow (no trees: pads keep only forest trees; grass has no collision). Paint features win over pads: keep them off the dev room's footprint.
